source: NASA POWER Zarr archive (AWS Open Data)

variable.definition: The total amount of ozone in a column extending vertically from the earth's surface to the top of the atmosphere.

grid.grid_reference: lat0/lon0 are the centre of the south-west cell; rows go north, columns east

processing: read the whole globe for the variable from the temporal (location-chunked) store, in latitude bands covering the full time axis
coarsened to 2 deg cells with edges at multiples of 2 from -90 / -180
each native cell is split between target cells in proportion to footprint overlap (native edges halfway between centres, clipped to +-90, longitude wraps)
cell value = mean of native cells weighted by cos(latitude of native centre) x assigned fraction, ignoring missing native cells (native polar rows get weight 0)
valid_fraction = weighted share of the cell's native area with data, per month
dropped 39 trailing time steps with no data (the store pre-allocates future dates)
kept source units; stored as float32 with zlib compression
